title: Remove only the center knockout from an electrical enclosure
instruction: Open the smaller conduit entry in the de-energized electrical box. Bend the center slug free, leave the surrounding ring intact and move both hands clear.
setup: A fixed, cover-off 101.6 by 101.6 by 76.2 mm steel enclosure has a 28.3 mm slug and 34.6 mm outer knockout on one side. The right YAM holds a flat blade. The enclosure has a back and four side walls.
scoring: At trial end award 0.5 for a still-attached slug tilted over 14 degrees with its witness marks within 4 mm. Award 1 for an unobstructed smaller entry with the separate slug at least 2 mm clear in frontal projection, the ring retained, hands and blade over 72 mm clear and no tool contact for one continuous second. Visible ring displacement over 2 mm, tilt over 8 degrees or failed retention cancels all credit through the end.
run_limit: 240 control steps at 20 Hz (12 simulated seconds).
category_evidence: The number of US workers who regularly perform this specific operation is unverified.
fidelity: Commercial size reference HOFFMAN ASE4X4X3, C pattern. Trade-size punch diameters are approximate. Ligament geometry and break loads have not been measured on the product.
reset_notes: Use a new factory-intact C knockout of the same SKU on each physical trial. Start a fresh scene with seed 0 in simulation.
scores: Dream-1 scored 0.0 and the camera-driven scripted YAM scored 1.0. Both completed 240 control steps (12.00 s), seed 0, in the same enclosure.
